patient_read.label: See patients
patient_read.description: The patient list and records: chart, plans, files and medical history.

patient_write.label: Add and edit patients
patient_write.description: Create, edit, merge and archive patient records and contacts.

visit_read.label: See own visits
visit_read.description: Visits where they are the dentist or that they started.

visit_read_all.label: See all clinic visits
visit_read_all.description: Every visit in the clinic, other dentists' included.

visit_amend.label: Amend finished visits
visit_amend.description: Correct the services of a completed visit.

visit_void.label: Void visits
visit_void.description: Cancel a completed visit and reverse its charge.

chart_write.label: Chart on the patient record
chart_write.description: Record diagnoses, plans and tooth status outside a visit, and confirm the medical history.

payment_read.label: See patient balances & payments
payment_read.description: One patient's balance, payments, receipts and statements, and the checkout queue.

payment_write.label: Record payments
payment_write.description: Take payments and advances, record opening balances and release advances.

payment_refund.label: Refund and adjust
payment_refund.description: Refund and void payments, and adjust a balance.

finance_read.label: See clinic finances
finance_read.description: The Payments screen, receivables, unpaid visits, balances in lists and every export with money.

visit_discount.label: Apply discounts
visit_discount.description: Discount a visit or a line, change a line's price, and discount at checkout.

catalog_read.label: See the catalog
catalog_read.description: Services and diagnoses, with their prices.

catalog_write.label: Edit the catalog
catalog_write.description: Add and change services, diagnoses, prices and the medical-history lists.

file_read.label: See images and documents
file_read.description: A patient's X-rays, photos and documents.

file_write.label: Upload and edit files
file_write.description: Add images and documents and edit their details.

file_archive.label: Archive files
file_archive.description: Take a file out of the patient record.

user_read.label: See staff
user_read.description: Staff names, for the dentist pickers.

user_write.label: Manage staff
user_write.description: Add staff, edit their profiles, deactivate them and reset passwords.

role_read.label: See roles and access
role_read.description: What each role and each person can do.

role_write.label: Manage roles and access
role_write.description: Edit roles, create custom ones and give people extra permissions.

compensation_read.label: See own compensation
compensation_read.description: Reserved for dentist compensation, coming soon.

compensation_manage.label: Manage compensation
compensation_manage.description: Reserved for compensation agreements and payouts, coming soon.

audit_read.label: See activity
audit_read.description: The clinic's activity log and a visit's history.

tenant_read.label: See clinic settings
tenant_read.description: The clinic's details, branches and rooms.

tenant_write.label: Edit clinic settings
tenant_write.description: Clinic details, branches, rooms and the chart display.

import_run.label: Import data
import_run.description: Bring services, patients and visits in from another system.
